summary: Tested 4 new features (bulk rack, camera scanner, Excel/PDF exports, pagination + category filter). Backend: 8/8 passing (1 skipped users-shape). Frontend: bulk-rack, exports, and pagination + kategori filter all work. CRITICAL: CameraScanButton crashes the entire page with 'Uncaught Cannot stop, scanner is not running or paused' whenever camera cannot be started (headless env, denied permission, or unmount before start resolves).

ui_bugs.issue: Opening camera dialog when getUserMedia fails (or dialog closes before start resolves) triggers uncaught synchronous error 'Cannot stop, scanner is not running or paused' from html5-qrcode. Emergent runtime error overlay appears and the whole page unmounts. Reproduces on inbound-camera-btn, bulk-rack-camera-btn, sales-camera-btn, cari-camera-btn (and by extension my-tasks-camera-btn). The .catch(() => {}) on scanner.stop() only catches promise rejections; html5-qrcode's stop() throws synchronously when not started.

action_items: Fix CameraScanner.jsx: wrap scanner.stop() cleanup in try/catch (sync guard), OR check scanner.getState()===2 (SCANNING) before calling stop(). Suggested cleanup: `return () => { try { if (scanner.getState && scanner.getState() === 2) { scanner.stop().then(()=>scanner.clear()).catch(()=>{}); } } catch(_) {} };`. Also wrap ScannerInner in an ErrorBoundary so a scanner failure shows a toast instead of crashing the tree. Camera failures should be graceful in headless/no-permission scenarios.

rca of the issue: CameraScanner useEffect cleanup calls scanner.stop().then().catch(). In html5-qrcode, when the scanner never entered SCANNING state (e.g., getUserMedia rejected in headless), stop() throws a synchronous Error 'Cannot stop, scanner is not running or paused'. This synchronous throw bypasses the promise .catch and becomes an uncaught error during React unmount, causing the parent tree to crash and the Emergent runtime overlay to appear. Mitigation: guard with scanner.getState() check and wrap in try/catch; also wrap ScannerInner in an ErrorBoundary.
